aliasConflicts.gapcode: appears only in the source's provider test table (src/app/api/providers/[id]/test/testUtils.js); the source registry, OAuth table and refresh table all use gapgpt. Not adopted as an id.
aliasConflicts.codex: shares the public client id app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann and the loopback redirect http://localhost:1455/auth/callback. The two are separate providers and separate connections; their sign-ins cannot run at the same time because both need port 1455.

repository.name: 9router
repository.note: PR title 'Fix/kiro reasoning text content fields' is stale; the head carries the GapGPT provider. Kiro MITM, tailscale and MITM-manager hunks are owned elsewhere and not touched here.

ownership.auth: this unit: provider object, token mapping, owned loopback callback and refresh helper; later the shared dispatch/refresh wiring in register-auth-06
ownership.upstream: provider registry row, registry index, executor mapping, model catalog, usage service, usage UI, provider test probe and icon. This unit edits none of them.

exports.index.js: public staging exports; no side effects on import, no listener, no timer

credential.gatewayCredential: first non-empty string of data.api_key, api_key, data.apiKey, apiKey, data.access_token, access_token; stored as both accessToken and apiKey
credential.refreshToken: stored only when the exchange returns a non-empty refresh_token
credential.expiry: expiresIn stored only when expires_in is a positive number; otherwise the key is treated as long-lived (expiresAt null)
credential.providerSpecificData: authMethod: pkce and credentialField (the field name, never the value)
credential.identity: the source exchange returns no account identity; every sign-in creates its own connection unless the flow carries a reconnect connectionId

modes.authorizationCodePkce: staged: S256 only, fixed redirect, client id bound into flow meta
modes.refresh: staged: refreshGapgptCredential, form-encoded refresh_token grant, used only when sign-in stored a refresh token
modes.deviceCode: inapplicable: no device endpoint in the source
modes.tokenImport: inapplicable: the source adds no import route or CLI credential reader
modes.manualCallbackPaste: inapplicable for this unit: the source modal falls back to manual input when the proxy is not active; the shared exchange route already handles pasted codes once providers.js registers gapgpt
modes.redirectFallback: not adopted: the source's Mode B 302 forwards an unregistered callback (and its code) to an app port

integration.registry: upstream lane: open-sse/providers/registry/gapgpt.js oauth block must equal GAPGPT_OAUTH_CONFIG; open-sse/providers/registry/index.js adds the row
integration.providerTable: auth06: src/lib/oauth/providers.js PROVIDERS.gapgpt = gapgptProvider (config replaced by GAPGPT_CONFIG once the registry row exists)
integration.redirectUri: auth06: src/lib/oauth/redirectUri.js buildOAuthRedirectUri returns GAPGPT_LOOPBACK_REDIRECT_URI for gapgpt, before the hosted branch, as Codex does
integration.fixedPortRoute: auth06: src/app/api/oauth/[provider]/[action]/route.js startFixedPortProxy, fixedPortStatus and stopFixedPortProxy add gapgpt through one module-level createGapgptLoopback({ listen: createNodeLoopbackListener(http.createServer), complete: exchangeAndSaveAuthorizationCode }); pass flowId, state and ownerId; map reason port_busy to OAUTH_FLOW_CONFLICT; do not call stop() before start() for gapgpt (that would drop other accounts' pending sign-ins)
integration.portSerialization: auth06: withFixedProxyOperation must key codex and gapgpt operations on the shared port (1455) so one cannot tear down the other's listener
integration.dashboardModal: auth06: src/shared/components/OAuthModal.js treats gapgpt as a fixed-port provider on 1455 (start-proxy, poll-status, stop-proxy) and shows success only on poll status done
integration.flowCompletion: no change: src/lib/oauth/flowCompletion.js already accepts an apiKey-only exchange and commits only while the flow claim is active
integration.tokenRefresh: auth06: open-sse/services/tokenRefresh.js REFRESH_HANDLERS.gapgpt calls refreshGapgptCredential(c.refreshToken, { proxyOptions }) and skips connections without a refresh token
integration.usage: upstream lane: open-sse/services/usage/gapgpt.js, open-sse/services/usage.js, ProviderLimits utils, USAGE_SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS
integration.executor: upstream lane: open-sse/executors/index.js maps gapgpt to the Codex executor
integration.catalog: ordered registration: shared catalog, registry index, models and storybook surfaces are not edited by this unit

restrictions: registered: false: GapGPT is not an active public provider until the upstream provider port and register-auth-06 land
no second auth store or framework: secrets stay in flowStore, completion goes through flowCompletion and the existing connection model
loopback only: binds 127.0.0.1:1455, accepts Host localhost:1455 or 127.0.0.1:1455, a loopback or absent Origin, GET on /auth/callback
unknown, replayed, cancelled, expired or mismatched callbacks never reach the exchange
no raw exchange body, non-JSON body, token or provider error description is returned or logged
synthetic credentials and mocked transports only; no live account, browser, socket or home store
